facts.value: As part of your study program in another department, you can complete certain modules in our Department of Economics, known as export modules. This includes optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between the departments.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: For the study programs of other departments, there is an overview compiled of which export modules you can register for in the Department of Economics and how you can integrate these export modules into your study program at your department.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Furthermore, you cannot integrate other modules from the Department of Economics into your study program at another department, nor can you obtain differing Credit Points (CP) from the Department of Economics.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt
